patterns.note: A literal blueprint grid background is used as a structural canvas across sections, reinforcing the concept of a creative workspace or drafting board.
Oversized, heavy grotesque sans-serif typography is contrasted with small, monospaced UI labels and metadata to create a technical yet editorial hierarchy.
A high-contrast monochrome base is punctuated by vibrant, solid primary and secondary accents (bright green, safety orange, canary yellow) used for interactive elements and geometric shapes.
The dot of the lowercase 'i' in the massive footer wordmark acts as a dynamic mask, cycling through different cinematic video clips and stills as the user interacts or scrolls.
Feature demonstrations are housed inside mock-OS window containers complete with window control dots, mimicking a desktop creative application.

technique_notes: Recreate the blueprint grid background using a CSS background-image with repeating linear-gradients, keeping the line weight extremely thin and the opacity low to prevent it from competing with content.

Implement the dynamic typography mask in the footer by absolute-positioning an auto-playing, muted HTML5 video element or a GSAP-driven image sequence directly over the dot of the lowercase 'i' in the SVG wordmark.
Use GSAP ScrollTrigger to animate the floating geometric shapes and data tags (e.g., '150K animations') with subtle parallax offsets as the user scrolls, giving a sense of depth to the flat layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Massive display headings (~6x body) with heavy weights, paired with small, clean monospaced labels for UI elements.

standout: The integration of live, cycling cinematic video clips directly inside the dot of the massive footer 'Flim' wordmark, turning a standard branding element into an active showcase of the product's visual library.
